Digitigrade_Endurance_Chassis.description: This digitigrade chassis, crafted from the resilient sinew and bone of a legendary canine, bolsters endurance and agility, enhancing its user's constitution and speed, and granting the skill Tireless, which allows for sustained high-speed chases without succumbing to fatigue.

Sloping_Hyena_Power_Frame.description: The Sloping_Hyena_Power_Frame is a robust and formidable chassis, its thick, muscular body built for endurance and strength, with a powerful jaw and sharp teeth that can tear through even the toughest materials, granting its bearer the might of a pack hunter and the resilience of a beast unyielding in the face of adversity.

Elongated_Maned_Wolf_Stilts.description: Elongated stilts sprout from the sinewy legs of this formidable maned wolf, granting it an otherworldly agility and reach that allow it to traverse treacherous terrain with effortless grace, while its thick mane bristles with primal energy.

Robust_Mastiff_Juggernaut_Core.description: The Robust_Mastiff_Juggernaut_Core is a colossal hulk of muscle and bone, its massive canine form brimming with raw power, designed for relentless brawling and unyielding defense, sacrificing agility for unparalleled strength and resilience.

Compact_Fox_Burrowing_Frame.description: This compact, fox-like frame is built for agility and swift movement, allowing its wielder to not only walk with grace but also to burrow through earth with astonishing ease, granting enhanced evasion and the ability to scale sheer surfaces as if they were nothing more than a gentle incline.

Skeletal_Undead_Hound_Chassis.description: The skeletal hound's chassis, a twisted amalgamation of bone and dark magic, carries the burden of a tormented canine soul, its joints creaking with each menacing step through the necrotic underbelies of the realm, granting its wielder resilience against the toxins of the underworld and a chilling aura that quells the hearts of the living.

Cybernetic_Alloy_Wolf_Spine.description: Embedded within the creature’s sinewy frame, the Cybernetic_Alloy_Wolf_Spine weaves a mesh of steel and sinew, augmenting its strength and resilience while granting it the ability to sprint through the battlefield with invincible ferocity, its very essence a blend of canine ferocity and mechanical might.

Hydrodynamic_Sea_Dog_Body.description: The Hydrodynamic Sea Dog Body is a marvel of aquatic engineering, blending the sleek, muscular build of a canine with the fluid grace of a marine predator, allowing for swift traversal both on land and in water, with enhanced agility and speed that enable a deadly Swim Dash maneuver.

Flexible_Dhole_Scrambling_Core.description: Embedded within the sinewy musculature of the Dhole, this core grants unparalleled agility and dexterity, allowing the creature to scale sheer surfaces and traverse treacherous terrains with preternatural ease, its lithe form a blur of motion as it weaves through the shadows.

Barrel_Chested_Barghest_Chassis.description: This monstrous creature boasts a barrel-chested frame, a testament to its sheer muscular bulk and mutant resilience, its canine features twisted and exaggerated into a nightmarish visage that strikes fear into the hearts of all who behold it.
